post.caption:
Seventeen hours awake puts your reaction times around a blood alcohol level of 0.05%. Twenty four roughly doubles it. Judgement goes first, then emotional control, then immunity. The genuinely dangerous part is that sleep deprivation removes your ability to detect sleep deprivation, so people tested while impaired rate themselves as fine. A tiny fraction of people carry a real short-sleep gene variant. It is rare enough that wondering whether you have it is a good sign you do not.
